response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, hands-on engineer with ~18 years of experience across web, mobile, and backend systems, including some high-throughput work at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic and recent AI-agent tooling exposure. However, the resume shows no experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, telemetry, or growth-measurement platform experience — the core of this role — and no evidence of Principal/IC6-level scope such as architecting systems adopted across multiple teams or driving multi-workstream initiatives at enterprise scale. Most roles are individual-contributor product work at small-to-mid-size companies.
strengths: Long, hands-on engineering career with breadth across languages (TypeScript, C/C++, Java, DLang) and stacks
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Recent AI-agent and MCP tooling work aligns with the AI-first engineering emphasis
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flighting, or telemetry/metrics platform experience
No demonstrated Principal-level scope: cross-team architecture ownership or org-wide platform adoption
No evidence of data science collaboration, statistical analysis, or growth/measurement domain work

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and distributed-systems exposure
